totp-generator.name: TOTP Generator
totp-generator.description: Generate time-based one-time passwords locally from a Base32 secret, with SHA-1/256/512, custom periods and test timestamps.

meta.title: TOTP Generator
meta.description: Generate time-based one-time passwords locally from a Base32 secret, with SHA-1/256/512, custom periods and test timestamps.
meta.keywords: TOTP Generator, TOTP, OTP, 2FA, RFC 6238, Base32, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512

totp.hint: Enter a Base32 secret, not an otpauth URI. Lowercase, ASCII whitespace and hyphen separators are accepted. Padding is optional. Maximum {limit} input characters.
totp.timeHint: Leave blank to use the device clock and refresh automatically after generating. Enter an integer to inspect a fixed time.
totp.emptyResult: Enter a Base32 secret and generate a code, or load the RFC 6238 example.
totp.rules: RFC 6238 with T0 = 0. The secret, hash, digits and period must match the verifier; live codes depend on the device clock. Secrets stay in this page’s memory and are excluded from copy and download.
totp.secretTooLong: Secret input must not exceed 1024 characters.
totp.invalidSecret: Invalid Base32 secret. Use A–Z and 2–7, with valid length, optional canonical padding and zero unused bits.
totp.invalidPeriod: Period must be an integer from 1 to 300 seconds.
totp.invalidTimestamp: Timestamp must be an integer from 0 to 253402300799 seconds.
